title: PixelPulse Sodium
description: PixelPulse Sodium is a performance-focused Minecraft modpack built for smooth gameplay without sacrificing visuals. It supercharges FPS, reduces lag, and keeps everything feeling fast and responsive using Sodium and carefully selected optimization mods.
body:
PixelPulse Sodium is a Minecraft modpack focused on maximizing performance and stability while preserving the vanilla look and feel of the game. Its primary purpose is to significantly improve FPS, reduce stuttering, and lower system resource usage by using Sodium and other carefully selected optimization mods.

The modpack is designed for players who want smoother gameplay on any system, from low-end PCs to high-refresh gaming setups. It improves rendering efficiency, chunk loading, and overall responsiveness without adding gameplay changes, new mechanics, or visual overhauls. PixelPulse Sodium functions as a drop-in performance upgrade, allowing players to enjoy Minecraft with faster load times, more consistent frame rates, and improved reliability.

If you have questions, encounter issues, or want to provide feedback, join the Discord to stay up to date and help shape future updates.
